title: PairingRequest
description: Body of POST /v1/pairing. The phone never sends the pairing code itself; it sends a proof that binds the code to the TLS certificate it connected to (see ADR 0010).

proof.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 with the pairing code as key over 'fieldnote-pair-v1|client|' + the certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint in lowercase hex.
